query:
DELETE FROM published_paths e
            WHERE e.id = ANY($1)
                AND NOT EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM upload_sessions u
                    WHERE u.cache_id = e.cache_id
                        AND u.store_path_hash = e.store_path_hash
                        AND (
                            u.status = 'finalizing'
                            OR (u.status IN ('pending', 'uploading', 'streaming') AND u.expires_at > NOW())
                        )
                )
